main.description: Stage 8/8 — Pipeline-driven publish. Loads approved composedPage rows for the chapter, writes a chapter master row, and emits a Tier 1 social post (AppBskyFeedPost) authored by the work's path-based DID. Distinct from com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.publishChapter (Worker-native stub) — this NSID is the BPMN-backed entry point that actually does the social post.

workDid.description: Path-based work DID, e.g. 'did:web:mangaka.etzhayyim.com:work:{rkey}'. Defaults to controller did:web:mangaka.etzhayyim.com.

announcementText.description: Optional override for the social post body.
